name: First screen duel
hypothesis: More first-time visitors run a check on a sample pull request from the first screen they land on.

agent_a.hypothesis: If the first screen gives one concrete harm, a single sample pull request and a button that promises a verdict, then more first-time visitors will run a check, because the action is visible, the stakes are clear and nothing has to be read or chosen first.

blocks.text: Catch the pull request that breaks your A/B test
Renaming a tracked event can quietly ruin a running experiment's data. Experiment Guard checks pull requests against your live Flagsmith experiments and blocks those. No account or install.

blocks.caption: Sample: renames the conversion event in one arm.

blocks.label: See if the guard blocks it

agent_b.hypothesis: If the first screen states the problem in plain words, shows one risky pull request and tells the visitor in two short steps what the button does, then more first-time visitors will press the check button, because they know what they will get and that it costs nothing.

blocks.text: Catch the pull request that breaks your A/B test
Experiment Guard checks each pull request against your running Flagsmith experiments and blocks changes that would corrupt their results.
